scope: Two isolated original MosRam sockets14/16 vs independent exact-advance/state adapters; matched50MHz staged-input/positive-edge neighbors,20ns embedded paths. Counts include shell/admin/pruning; no full MemX/global barrier/physical FPGA save/load or speed qualification.

14.scope: Single original14/16-bit MosRam socket; complete modeled bit state, not global consumers/phase/backend or machine snapshots

16.scope: Single original14/16-bit MosRam socket; complete modeled bit state, not global consumers/phase/backend or machine snapshots
